cooks_secret.title: Cook's Secret
cooks_secret.description: Little Cook approaches you and quietly asks for help. Tomorrow is a holiday — the anniversary of the palanka's founding — and 🧑Naum Lysenko. Ingulsk Kurinnyi|Naum asked her to prepare a festive feast. But there's a problem: she wants to cook a legendary kulesh (millet porridge) from her grandmother's recipe, and she's missing two things — steppe honey and a special clay makhitra (cooking pot) in which kulesh turns out different from a regular cauldron. "I'm ashamed to ask the Cossacks — they'll say it's women's business. And the holiday is tomorrow, and I won't manage alone. Help me — I'll feed you so well that even 💵🧑Honta|Honta will lick his fingers."
rewards: Daily portion of kulesh from Little Cook (restores health)
If you brought Tykhon Medovyk to the feast — he becomes accessible as a honey merchant near the palanka (once a week)
Respect from 🧑Naum Lysenko. Ingulsk Kurinnyi|Naum: *"I see you can help with more than just arrows. Good."*
If Hryts helped — he receives praise from Naum for initiative (affects his arc in ❔Unlucky)

curse.title: Curse
curse.description: You return to 🧑Ostap Vernydub|Ostap on the swamp. He sits by the fire and without greetings says: "It's a Shapeshifter. I knew he would return. Thirty years ago there was one just like him — barely drove him away with a group. You can't kill a Shapeshifter simply. The blade must be coated with poison from aconite and mavka bile. I can brew it, but I need the bile. And Mavky|mavky live on my very swamp... I'm not going to fight them."
walkthrough: **Taught honestly** → Hryts comes on his own: *"I heard you're going after the Shapeshifter? I'm with you. I shoot better now!"* — becomes a companion, helps in the fight with mavky.
**Gave fur (deception)** → Hryts comes too, but in battle misses and flees — no help.

**If 🧑Taras Chub trusts you** (quest ❔Wolf Attack): he'll say exactly where he saw the Shapeshifter: *"He comes to the watering hole when the moon is over the ravine. Wait for him there."* — exact location, easier to find.
**If ❔Wolf Attack wasn't done**: must search yourself, wandering the steppe at night, risking running into wolf packs.
🧑Hryts Dovbnia (if taught honestly) — shoots from the flank
💵🧑Honta|Honta can be called for extra pay
With coated weapon — realistically killable at this level
rewards: **Shapeshifter hide** — rare material: 🧑 💵Kozhem'yaka will buy for a huge sum, OR 🧑 💵Bosper can make armor from it
🧑Ostap Vernydub|Ostap becomes a permanent trader in rare potions
🧑Naum Lysenko. Ingulsk Kurinnyi|Naum Lysenko greatly increases respect for the hero
🧑Taras Chub smiles for the first time: *"Quiet now. Good."*
If 🧑Hryts Dovbnia|Hryts survived and helped — he is accepted into the Ingulsk hunters (his arc concludes)

swamp_healer.title: Swamp Healer
swamp_healer.description: 🧑 💵Pechyborshch says: "I need the root of a black willow that only grows in the swamp. I won't go there myself — my legs aren't what they used to be, and in the swamp... it's unclean. But without the root I can't brew a fever remedy. And three people in the palanka already have fever."
walkthrough: Option 3: Tell about the howling (requires [[❔Wolf Attack]])
rewards: 🧑 💵Pechyborshch brews potions, heals the sick, gives several free potions
If you befriended 🧑Ostap Vernydub|Ostap — quest ❔Curse opens

unlucky.title: Unlucky
unlucky.description: 🧑Hryts Dovbnia pulls you aside: "Listen, friend, help me out... 💵🧑Honta gave me a trial — bring the fur of a wolf I killed myself. And I... well, you understand. I shoot like a blind man. Maybe you could bring me the fur? I'll say I killed it myself. Honta won't find out."
rewards: **Option 1:** Hryts is grateful but incompetent
**Option 2:** Hryts becomes a reliable companion
**Option 3:** 💵🧑Honta gives arrows and some free training for honesty

wolf_attack.title: Wolf Attack
wolf_attack.description: 🧑Taras Chub stands near a pen with a mauled sheep. He says briefly: "Wolves. The third one this week. Usually they don't come this close. Something is driving them here from the steppe. At least kill those near the pasture — I'll pay."
rewards: Money
Wolf hides
🧑Taras Chub begins to trust the hero

first_hunt.title: First Hunt
first_hunt.description: After completing previous tasks 🧑Naum Lysenko. Ingulsk Kurinnyi says: "Well then, you're not entirely hopeless. But in Ingulsk every Cossack must be a hunter. Words are not enough — show what you can do. Go to the steppe, bring me a saiga carcass. Not just any one — I need an old male with large horns. These aren't easy to find. Talk to the lads, maybe someone can point you in the right direction."
walkthrough: **Have marker from Taras** → go straight to the dry ravine, find the saiga without wandering.
**Have only Honta's advice** → need to search near ravines with water, check several locations before finding it.
**Asked no one** → wander the steppe for a long time; wolves may attack along the way; eventually find the herd but not the old male. Find the male further on — separately.
**With Honta's poisoned arrows** → the saiga slows down, can be finished with a second shot.
**With Pechyborshch's potion** → you see the saiga from a distance; the first shot from ideal position — better chance of killing outright.
**Without preparation** → need to chase it and shoot on the run. Difficult, can miss and need to find another.
rewards: Naum Lysenko's respect (brings you closer to joining the palanka)
Saiga horns (can be sold to 🧑 💵Kozhem'yaka|Kozhem'yaka or 🧑 💵Bosper|Bosper)
If you took Hryts — 2 rabbit skins (small bonus)
If you did everything perfectly (spoke to everyone, killed with first shot) — Naum also gives a **hunting knife**: *"Here. A real hunter without a knife is no hunter."*

hunters_dispute.title: Hunters' Dispute
hunters_dispute.description: You approach 🧑Naum Lysenko. Ingulsk Kurinnyi|Naum, and he sits by his kurin rubbing his temples: "Oh dear... Two fools have driven the whole palanka mad. Khoma Riznyk and Opanas Kryvyi — went hunting for a deer together, and now they can't divide the catch. Khoma says — he fired the arrow that stopped the deer. Opanas says — he finished it off and skinned it. Both are telling the truth, and both have been eating my head. Go sort it out, because I can't look at them anymore."
